description: Ensemble des données concernant les réseaux de transports en commun (GTFS et temps réel) is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. La Métropole d'Aix-Marseille-Provence ouvre ses données publiques "Transport" afin de favoriser l’émergence d’applications dans le domaine. Vous trouverez un ensemble de fichiers contenant la description complète des lignes des différents réseaux partenaires aux format GTFS et au format SIRI. Pour ce dernier, le n ombre de requêtes est limité à 10-20 par minute. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are réseaux, GTFS, siri, transport. The portal shows 45 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-04-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
